es.resumen: Blondie es una perrita tímida; solo necesita que le brindes un poco de tu amor y paciencia.
es.historia: Blondie es una perrita miedosa ; le tomó bastante tiempo adaptarse, pero ahora está mucho mejor. Buscamos una familia que le brinde la oportunidad de sentirse segura; con un poco de paciencia, su personalidad cariñosa saldrá a relucir.

en.resumen: Blondie is a shy little doggy; she just needs you to give her a bit of your love and patience.
en.historia: Blondie is a very timid dog; it took her quite some time to adjust, but she is doing much better now. We are looking for a family that will give her the chance to feel secure—with a bit of patience, her affectionate personality will shine through.
